text:
Carmen (growth): quick flag — Friday KPI deck shows a spike in webinar signups overnight, but paid spend doesn't match. can someone sanity-check?
Ian (analytics): pulling hourly funnel now. link: https://app.redwood.com/dashboards/webinar-kpi?range=48h
Ian (analytics): signups +310 between 00:50-01:30 UTC, paid clicks only +12. conversion quality lower (bounce up). looks like attribution drift.
Rhea (ops): checking click logs for that window. 1,200 clicks; 42 missing utm_campaign. user-agent for missing: mostly Android webview.
Noah (ads): we ran a small APAC boost at 00:45 UTC (campaign=apac_march_test). should be tagged.
SysBot: pipeline note: ingest-2026-04-02T01:05Z processed; 42 anomalous rows flagged: missing utm_campaign.
Carmen (growth): ok — action items: 1) annotate dashboard and weekly KPI doc; 2) flag affected leads as "review" in KPI sheet; 3) pause nurture for flagged IDs to avoid duplicate outreach.
Ian (analytics): will add annotation and compute pre/post CAC impact for Friday. preliminary est: reclassifying 42 leads to paid shifts CAC ~8% for this cohort.
Rhea (ops): creating ticket MKT-6210 "apac webview strips campaign param" and assigning to eng-redirects. quick mitigation: append campaign server-side on first redirect. infra ETA 4 hrs.
Noah (ads): also propose adding a client-side fallback to set campaign if missing via landing JS. low-risk quick win.
Carmen (growth): please add a one-line note in the KPI deck: "04/02 attribution drift due to webview param loss; reclassification pending rejoin."
Ian (analytics): scheduling rejoin job after infra patch; will post reproc sample when done.
Rhea (ops): holding nurture for the 42 IDs and tagging them "hold-reclass" in CRM.
Carmen (growth): great. follow-ups: Rhea — ticket + CRM hold; Ian — annotation + pre/post numbers; Noah — client fallback exploration. well review updated metrics in Friday sync. :white_check_mark:
